Variants.Content: The Caswell family is based on Bitterbridge and is a local noble on the border between the Reach and the Riverlands. The Bitter Bridge spans roads and rivers, connecting the Highgarden direction, the King's Road and the Trident's trade route; whoever controls the bridge can collect tolls, arrange garrison and hear news from various places. The family reputation of Casway was derived not only from its vassal lineage but also from its bridges, fairs, grain carts, and ability to repair roads after floods. The roses in the river bend are not that important here. What really matters is whether the bridge deck can withstand wheels, military horses and year after year of wind and rain.

The border princes looked at Casway to see if they could turn a bridge into a stable income and defense line. If the bridge is in good order, Casway deserves respect; if the tolls rise randomly with the war, the neighboring lords will soon regard the family as a nuisance rather than a barrier.

Businessmen calculate the bridge tax, soldiers calculate the width of the bridge, and farmers calculate the wheat bags washed away by the flood. The power of Casway falls on everyone who crosses the bridge, so everyone has his or her own account against the family. A good bridge owner will make people complain less; a bad bridge owner will make everyone remember his name.
